vram_note: vram_mb / vram_peak_mb nulled on 2026-11-22 (Task 13b): this speed run used the warm-up load, whose memory lingers in nvidia-smi, so its readings were inflated; the valid VRAM values are in phase1_vram.json (a separate pass with --warmup 0). The harness (bench/run_bench.py) was changed after this run: it now stores no VRAM when the load is used, and samples the SM clock only during the timed repetitions (this file's sm_clock_mhz still covers 1 s after the load stopped to the end, including llama-bench's untimed warm-up pass).
